name: Katie Smits
prior_offices: Teton County treasurer (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Katie Smits is the Teton County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she, a Republican, ran unopposed in the general election.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, Nov. 4, 2026, Ashlee Nader wins race for Teton County assessor
